description.en-US: Human-readable document number, generated at create time and never supplied by the client. Immutable, for the same reason as inventory_stock_transfer.transfer_number: it is the reference quoted on paperwork, so renumbering would orphan every mention of it.
The upstream document that caused this scrap. A plain string because the originating modules are outside Inventory and may not exist.
The transfer this scrap arose from, when damage was found while processing one (BR 4.2.9.2, optional). Not the movement this scrap generates — that is move_id.

Unit the quantity is expressed in. Named base_uom_id to match inventory_stock_quant rather than the requirement's uom_id, because a scrap quantity has to line up with the balance it is drawn from. Optional for the same reason it is optional on the quant: quantities are always kept in the variant's base unit, so the unit is derivable from the variant and naming it is a convenience rather than a fact the document owns. BR 4.2.9.2 lists uom_id as required, but requiring an id no caller can resolve yet would block every scrap until Uom master data is wired in.
Lot or serial identifier of the goods scrapped. Empty string, never null, matching the quant dimension it must line up with (see inventory_stock_quant.lot_ref).
Package the goods were taken from. Empty string, never null, for the same reason as lot_ref.
Owner of the goods when they are not the company's. Empty string, never null, for the same reason as lot_ref.
Where the goods are scrapped from. Must hold the balance the scrap draws down.
Where the goods go. A location of kind 'scrap', which is outside usable stock, so the movement removes them from availability without deleting the history (BR 4.2.9.1).
How much to scrap, strictly greater than zero (BR 4.2.9.3). The zero lower bound here is the storage floor; the service rejects zero, which a schema minimum cannot express.
Why the goods were scrapped, as a short code. A plain string rather than an enum because the reason list is configuration a deployment sets, not a domain constant.
Two states only (BR 4.2.9.2). There is no cancelled: an unwanted draft is deleted, and a done scrap is corrected by a reverse movement, never by reopening it.
The movement Do Scrap generated. Empty until the scrap is done, and the audit trail from the document to the stock it removed.
When Do Scrap ran. Set together with status 'done' and the move, never independently.
